charred cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls; fire contained to kitchen with fire extinguisher

input.rationale: Fire damage to policyholder's own property from a covered peril (stove grease flare-up) with no third-party fault and no injuries; damage confined to kitchen cabinets and surrounding surfaces.
Charred cabinetry and smoke damage across multiple kitchen surfaces represents moderate damage, with no injuries; estimated loss likely in the $5,000–$50,000 range pending adjuster inspection.

input.claim_summary: Kitchen fire caused by stove grease flare-up; charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls; fire contained with extinguisher. No injuries. Damage confined to kitchen. Medium severity, $500 deductible, $250k coverage limit.
